replies.author: halkenburgoito
replies.body: its very easy compared to actually making it, that's why you use Ai

replies.author: ShorrapanGame
replies.body: I'm solo dev and it's only way make my dream come true. Of course it's easier than paint yourself but you can't imagine how difficult it is to build a scene from scratch so that you like it. don't break anything in it, and there are many more subtle points. Photoshop is also a tool and makes the artist's work much easier, but no one scolds him for using it. The text, the story, the plot, I did everything myself. Every word

replies.author: halkenburgoito
replies.body:
And people did Solo Dev *before* AI existed, so its not the only way, that's just not true. And photoshop doesn't do it for them(atleast not until it added gen Ai), and in photoshop you have 100% control over the output.

with Ai, you take too much credit, the AI does most of the work *and* descisions. "A painting is a 1000 words they say." Describing the idea of a painting vs making a descision of each brush stroke is not the same, one is creating it, the other is asking another thing to create it. You *did* not do everything yourself.

Just a fact, its the *reason* why you used Ai.

replies.author: ShorrapanGame
replies.body:
Yes and I never said I did Myself everything. The Demo version of game will be free and if people support me I will get artist who will paint it.

As for artificial intelligence, people developed games, I also agree with that, I just chose such a specific genre where everything depends on art, but I don't have such a skill.

comments.author: Illustrious_Cat_2870
comments.body: The video is nice, but I dont know what the game is about, if the video had an intention to be a trailer or something, it does not give too much clue to the viewer, but as a cinematic, it is very good quality

replies.author: ShorrapanGame
replies.body:
It's just intro when you start game. 

It's a dark surrealist visual novel about a young man living under a crimson sky in a city ruled by priests who use faith as a tool of control. The story explores what happens when you start questioning a system that everyone around you accepts as sacred. 
The story is entirely written by me. every word. It all started when I started writing a book a long time ago and decided to visualize it. The game will be adult, with adult questions and ambiguous answers to them.

replies.author: ShorrapanGame
replies.body: Anyway thanks for comment and your opinion!

comments.author: Lucaslouch
comments.body: it’s pretty nice! the atmosphere is very interesting, quite dark. the kid with the tree surprised me a bit though. it could definitely go into my own game though 😁. may i ask you how much it costed you approximately? with the trial and error and taking into account all the engines you listed above?

replies.author: ShorrapanGame
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! The game will be a visual novel. the focus is on the text, plot, visual and philosophy of the game and that everything is logical. There will also be game mechanics. What kind of game do you want to make? I spent about $300 and only at the beginning of the journey. but there were a lot of errors while testing different services. I have one big scene ready, and there are 3 more big scenes planned in the demo version. to hire an artist for one background and character, $500. Only the first scene would have cost a minimum of $1,500, so I decided to go the other way.

replies.author: ShorrapanGame
replies.body: Thank you bro! to begin with, I experimented with the visual for a long time to get the right picture. then I took different shots and brought them to life using kling AI  and runaway.I took a lot of shots and then edited everything myself. the music is someone else's, but I voiced the text of the poem with ElevenLabs. It's just intro for my Visual Novel game
